info.name: Noun Project API V2 Autocomplete Icon API

params.name: query
params.description: Search term used to match icon titles, tags, and descriptions.

params.name: styles
params.description: Comma-separated icon styles to filter by. Common values include `solid` and `line`.

params.name: line_weight
params.description: Line weight in pixels (1-60) at 512-pixel rendering. Only meaningful for line-style icons.

params.name: limit_to_public_domain
params.description: When true, restricts results to icons released to the public domain.

params.name: thumbnail_size
params.description: Pixel dimension for returned thumbnail URLs.

params.name: blacklist
params.description: When true, applies the client's configured blocklist to results.

params.name: include_svg
params.description: When true, includes raw SVG markup in each icon result.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of icons returned per page.

params.name: prev_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for backward pagination.

params.name: next_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for forward pagination.

items.docs: Search the Noun Project icon library by query term with optional filters for style, line weight, public-domain status, and thumbnail size. Returns a paginated list of matching icons.

params.name: icon_id
params.description: Numeric identifier of the icon.

params.name: thumbnail_size
params.description: Pixel dimension for the returned thumbnail URL.

params.name: blacklist
params.description: When true, returns 404 if the icon is on the client's blocklist.

items.docs: Retrieve a single icon by its numeric identifier with full metadata.

params.name: icon_id
params.description: Numeric identifier of the icon.

params.name: query
params.description: Optional search term to narrow similar-icon candidates.

params.name: limit_to_public_domain
params.description: When true, restricts results to icons released to the public domain.

params.name: thumbnail_size
params.description: Pixel dimension for returned thumbnail URLs.

params.name: blacklist
params.description: When true, applies the client's configured blocklist to results.

params.name: include_svg
params.description: When true, includes raw SVG markup in each icon result.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of icons returned per page.

params.name: prev_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for backward pagination.

params.name: next_page
params.description: Cursor token returned by a prior response for forward pagination.

items.docs: Find icons stylistically similar to the supplied icon ID, optionally narrowed by a query term. Used to assemble visually consistent icon sets from a single seed.

params.name: icon_id
params.description: Numeric identifier of the icon.

params.name: color
params.description: Hexadecimal color value (without leading `#`) used to recolor the icon. Defaults to the icon's original color.

params.name: filetype
params.description: Output file format.

params.name: size
params.description: PNG pixel dimension (20-1200). Ignored for SVG downloads which scale infinitely.

items.docs: Download a rendered icon in SVG or PNG format with optional hex-color recoloring and pixel sizing (PNG only). The response body is the icon binary; the content-type matches the requested filetype.
